scenario: Run weather-qml on one V1.2 kit with temperatures 21 and -8 in the same process. Repeat on a normal R4 boot using the existing executable and check the physical screen.
expected: The renderer completes the initial scene presentation and a second presentation after the temperature update.
observed: Both runs completed two scene presentations. On R4, one program owned the display, read -8 from stdin and continued after the SSH session closed. The operator confirmed -8 C on the physical panel. RSS samples were 468 KiB in the original run and 908 KiB in the R4 run.
limits: Both observations concern the same kit and executable. RSS is a point-in-time sample for each process, not a peak.
The physical observation covers the final temperature in the R4 run. The update input was a test value.
